subject: biology

hotspots.label: Bronchi
hotspots.description: The two main branches of the windpipe that carry air into each lung.
hotspots.function: Split the airflow into the two lungs.

hotspots.label: Bronchioles
hotspots.description: The smaller branching tubes that carry air deeper into the lung.

hotspots.label: Alveoli
hotspots.description: Millions of tiny air sacs where oxygen and carbon dioxide are exchanged.
hotspots.function: Where oxygen enters the blood and CO2 leaves it.
hotspots.positionHint: At the ends of the bronchioles.

hotspots.label: Pleura membrane
hotspots.description: The smooth membrane wrapping the lungs.
hotspots.function: Smooth covering that lets the lungs glide as they breathe.
hotspots.positionHint: Around the outside of each lung.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette beneath the model, no floor grid, no scene props. The organ floats large and centered, lit with soft neutral studio light (no rim glow, no bloom, no emissive anywhere). Clean stylized-specimen quality matching the reference organ specimens - smooth continuous topology, medical-illustration-meets-product-render, not photoreal, not cartoon. COLOR IS RESTRAINED: the organ reads as a warm-paper specimen with a faint informational cast per structure, never a saturated legend color. Strong saturated color is reserved entirely for the small flat-colored hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.6, single 2K shared texture atlas where possible, baked AO. No subsurface scattering, no specular sheen. Cross-sections are clean flat-capped museum cuts, never gory or torn tissue. No emissive channels anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a single lung (right) as a stylized-specimen study, opened in clean cutaway to show the branching airway tree. From the hilum, a main bronchus splits into bronchioles and finally into clusters of tiny rounded alveoli. The pleura surface is smooth; the cut is a clean museum cap. Warm paper palette, muted greys/soft pink, no glow. Named nodes: LungSurface, MainBronchus, Bronchiole01-06, AlveoliClusters, Pleura. Budget 20-30k.
